headline: Automated tools retrieve, select and manage microbial and proteomic data
label: Biological Data Resource Infrastructure
summary: Items from January 2026 describe tools that automate retrieval, parameter selection and data management across public and in-house biological resources.
synthesis: The common thread is automation of routine data-handling steps that otherwise depend on manual lookup or configuration. Ratatoskr is a Python tool that automates retrieval of type strain sequences and metadata from LPSN, BacDive and NCBI, handling synonym-based differences across these resources. GenomeDepot is an open-source web platform for annotating, managing and comparatively analyzing microbial genomes, with BLAST search and genome browsing. QuickSearchProt, which is more distant from resource curation, selects search parameter values for X!Tandem and Sage from a small spectral subset for DDA data. Taken together, the items address the front end of data reuse: sourcing reference records, organizing genome collections and configuring analyses before results are produced. What is new is the emphasis on automating these steps against established external resources and reference data. The items do not report usage or adoption metrics, so their practical uptake remains undocumented.
